info.longName: WisdomTree Emerging Markets Quality Dividend Growth Fund

funds_data.description: The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities of dividend-paying emerging market issuers that exhibit growth characteristics and/or investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially similar to the economic characteristics of such securities. It is non-diversified.
